subject: Next steps & budget owner confirmation — MedGen follow-up
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medgen.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medgen.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & budget owner confirmation — MedGen follow-up

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery:

- Primary use case: Triage & summarization for outpatient case notes to reduce clinician typing time.
- Expected pilot: ~6 clinicians, 5k notes/mo initially, with target scale to 50 clinicians if accuracy/latency look good.
- Success criteria: >= 70% time saved per note (measured via time-and-motion sample), no PHI exfiltration, latency under 400ms p50 for single-note inference.

Action items we agreed on:
1) Confirm the economic/budget owner who signs pilot spend (~$15k/mo) so we can draft an internal proposal.
2) Priya to share MedGen procurement timeline & required PO/negotiation steps.
3) Neha will send our security one-pager and SOC2 artifact list.
4) We will circulate a short SOW and pilot plan by EOD tomorrow.

Two quick questions for you both: who is ultimately responsible for the budget approval (title & email), and is there an internal security/process gate we should plan for before pilot kickoff (info sec review, legal questionnaire, or procurement approval)?

I’ve attached the Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf and a one-pager on the pilot approach. I’m looping in Neha (security) and Dev (solutions) to keep the flow tight.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf, MedGen_MA_Platform_OnePager.pdf

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medgen.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medgen.com>
Cc: procurement@medgen.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & budget owner confirmation — MedGen follow-up

Monica —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers:

- Economic owner: Chief Medical Information Officer — Dr. Ritu Menon (ritu.menon@medgen.com). She owns budget for clinical workflows and pilot approvals.
- Procurement leads: Priya is correct; procurement@medgen.com handles the PO and terms. Expect their initial review within 7–10 business days once a draft SOW is submitted.
- Security gate: We do have an InfoSec intake form and an internal security review that typically runs 2–3 weeks. For pilots involving PHI we also need a brief DPIA (data processing impact assessment).

I’ll intro Dr. Menon on the thread if that helps — but she prefers a 15-min briefing before any contractual ask. Could you prepare a one-slide cost/benefit and a short pilot timeline for that call?

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Director, Clinical Transformation | MedGen Health
sanjay@medgen.com

On attachments: I see the security summary — looks good at a glance. Please also include any relevant data retention and deletion language for the pilot in the SOW.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medgen.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@medgen.com>, Dr. Ritu Menon <ritu.menon@medgen.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & budget owner confirmation — MedGen follow-up

Thanks Sanjay — copied Dr. Menon to keep things moving. Dr. Menon — great to meet you (virtually). Per Sanjay’s note, we can keep the briefing tight: 15 minutes to share the pilot goals, timeline, and expected outcomes. Proposed slots: Thu 16 Sep 10:00AM PT or Fri 17 Sep 2:00PM PT — which works best?

I’ve attached a short 1-slide Cost/Benefit and the draft SOW (RWI_SOW_template_v2.docx) with pilot-specific language:
- Pilot length: 6 weeks
- Population: 6 clinicians, 5k notes/month
- Pricing: $15k/month for pilot environment + $500 flat onboarding fee
- Data handling: strict on-prem proxying option + 30-day retention, automatic purge after pilot (we can adjust per DPIA)

Neha — could you confirm whether the DPIA checklist we sent last quarter will suffice or if MedGen needs additional artifacts? If you could bullet the earliest-info-sec-asks (e.g., pen-test window, SOC2 cert copy, encryption-in-transit details) I’ll forward to procurement.

Next steps from our side (tentative timeline):
- Wed EOD: Finalize SOW & send to procurement
- Thu: 15-min briefing with Ritu (if she confirms)
- Week+2: InfoSec intake submitted; procurement review begins

Thanks all — looking forward to closing the loop quickly.

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
(Attached: RWI_SOW_template_v2.docx)

Hi all — quick note from security so you have clarity before the briefing:

Key documents we will provide immediately:
- SOC 2 Type II summary (last 12 months)
- Data flow diagram for the pilot architecture (proxy + tokenization layer)
- Encryption-at-rest and in-transit details, plus KMS options for customer-managed keys

Items we’ll need from MedGen to expedite intake:
1) DPIA contact and brief (point person) and example sample data fields for the notes (PHI classification)
2) Whether MedGen requires ePHI to remain in their VPC or if a proxied-hosted approach is acceptable
3) Any contractual language procurement expects around breach notifications and audit rights

If Dr. Menon wants a 10–15 minute security overview in the briefing, I can join and walk through the high level. Otherwise I’ll send the artifacts to procurement after we have an agreed SOW.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
